description: Save a character (a person, from 3-5 photos) or an element (product, outfit, location, prop, style) to the user's Character Studio library. Afterwards write @Name in any prompt to use it. List saved ones with pixeldojo_library source=characters.

description.description: Optional appearance notes, or the scene text for an element without photos.

image_urls.description: Photos of it. For a person, 3 to 5 clear photos from different angles. Required for a character.

kind.description: character (default), product, outfit, location, object (a prop) or style.

name.description: What to call it. Used as @Name in prompts afterwards.

name: pixeldojo_save_character
title: Save character or element
